question: What are the eligibility criteria for admission?
answer: Students must have completed 10+2 (or equivalent) with a minimum of 50% aggregate marks from a recognized board. Some programs may have specific subject requirements.

question: How can I apply for admission to the college?
answer: You can apply online through our official college website. Fill out the application form, upload required documents, and pay the application fee online.

question: What documents are required for admission?
answer: Required documents include: 10th and 12th marksheets, transfer certificate, migration certificate, passport-size photographs, ID proof (Aadhar/PAN), and category certificate if applicable.

question: What is the admission process for engineering courses?
answer: Engineering admissions are based on JEE Main scores. Candidates must apply through the state counseling portal and appear for document verification after seat allotment.

question: Is there a management quota for admissions?
answer: Yes, a limited number of seats are available under management quota. Contact the admissions office for details on eligibility and fees under this category.

question: What is the last date for submitting the admission form?
answer: The last date for admission form submission is typically in June-July for the upcoming academic session. Please check the official website for the exact deadline.

question: Can I apply for lateral entry admission?
answer: Yes, lateral entry admission is available for diploma holders into the second year of B.Tech programs. Eligibility requires a diploma with minimum 60% marks.

question: What is the intake capacity for each course?
answer: Intake capacity varies by course: B.Tech has 60 seats per branch, BCA has 60 seats, BBA has 60 seats, and MBA has 60 seats per specialization.

question: What undergraduate courses are offered by the college?
answer: The college offers B.Tech (multiple branches), BCA, BBA, B.Sc., B.Com., and BA programs at the undergraduate level.

question: What postgraduate courses are available?
answer: Postgraduate programs include M.Tech, MBA, MCA, M.Sc., and M.Com. Some departments also offer research programs leading to Ph.D.

question: What are the branches available in B.Tech?
answer: B.Tech branches include Computer Science Engineering, Electronics and Communication, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Electrical Engineering, and Information Technology.

question: What is the duration of the B.Tech program?
answer: The B.Tech program is a 4-year (8 semesters) full-time undergraduate degree program.

question: Does the college offer any diploma programs?
answer: Yes, the college offers 3-year diploma programs in Engineering through the polytechnic wing. Courses include Mechanical, Civil, Computer Science, and Electronics.

question: Are there any certificate courses or short-term programs?
answer: Yes, we offer short-term certificate courses in areas like Python Programming, Web Development, Data Science, Digital Marketing, and Soft Skills Development.

question: Is B.Tech Computer Science available with AI and ML specialization?
answer: Yes, B.Tech CSE with AI and ML specialization is available. This program covers machine learning, deep learning, data science, and artificial intelligence fundamentals.

question: What elective subjects are available in the final year?
answer: Final year elective subjects vary by branch. CSE electives include Cloud Computing, Cybersecurity, IoT, Blockchain, and Natural Language Processing.

question: What is the annual tuition fee for B.Tech?
answer: The annual tuition fee for B.Tech is approximately Rs. 85000 to Rs. 120000 depending on the branch. Fees may vary based on government regulations.

question: What are the hostel charges per year?
answer: Hostel charges range from Rs. 45000 to Rs. 70000 per year depending on the room type (single, double, or triple sharing) and facilities included.

question: Is the college fee refundable if I withdraw from admission?
answer: Fee refund is processed according to the UGC refund policy. If withdrawal is before the last date of admission, a significant portion is refunded after deducting processing charges.

question: Are there any payment plans or installment options for fees?
answer: Yes, fees can be paid in two installments per semester. Students may also apply for educational loans through our tie-up banks. Contact the accounts office for details.

question: What is the application fee for the admission form?
answer: The application fee is Rs. 500 for general category students and Rs. 250 for SC/ST/OBC category students. This fee is non-refundable.

question: Are there any additional fees apart from tuition?
answer: Additional fees include examination fees, library fees, laboratory fees, sports fees, and student activity fees. These are charged separately each semester.

question: Does the college accept online fee payment?
answer: Yes, fees can be paid online through the student portal using net banking, credit card, debit card, or UPI. Payment receipts are generated automatically.

question: How is the examination system structured in the college?
answer: The examination system follows a semester pattern. Each semester has internal assessments (40%) and end-semester examinations (60%). Internal marks include assignments, quizzes, and mid-term tests.

question: When are the semester examinations usually conducted?
answer: End-semester examinations are held in November-December for odd semesters and April-May for even semesters. Exact dates are announced through the academic calendar.

question: What is the passing criteria for each subject?
answer: Students must secure a minimum of 40% marks in each subject, with a minimum of 35% in the end-semester exam and 40% in internal assessments.

question: How can I apply for re-evaluation of my answer sheet?
answer: Re-evaluation applications can be submitted through the examination section within 15 days of result declaration. A fee of Rs. 500 per subject is applicable.

question: What happens if I fail in one or more subjects?
answer: Students who fail subjects can appear for supplementary examinations. These are typically held 1-2 months after the main examination results are declared.

question: How can I obtain my mark sheet and degree certificate?
answer: Mark sheets are issued after each semester. The degree certificate is issued after the successful completion of the entire program. Apply through the examination section with required fees.

question: Is there a provision for grace marks in examinations?
answer: Yes, grace marks up to a maximum of 5 marks per subject are awarded to help borderline students pass, as per university guidelines.

question: What are the library working hours?
answer: The library is open from 8:00 AM to 8:00 PM on weekdays. On Saturdays, it operates from 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM. The library remains closed on Sundays and public holidays.

question: How many books can a student borrow at a time?
answer: Undergraduate students can borrow a maximum of 3 books at a time for a period of 14 days. Postgraduate students and faculty can borrow 5 books.

question: Does the library provide access to online journals and e-books?
answer: Yes, the library provides access to digital resources through NPTEL, DELNET, and various e-journal subscriptions. Students can access these resources using their college login credentials.

question: What is the fine for late return of library books?
answer: A fine of Rs. 2 per book per day is charged for late returns. Fines must be cleared before borrowing new books or during semester fee payment.

question: Can students access the library during examination periods?
answer: Yes, the library has extended hours during examination periods, typically opening at 7:00 AM and closing at 10:00 PM to support student preparation.

question: What is the average placement package offered to students?
answer: The average placement package for B.Tech graduates ranges from Rs. 3.5 to 6 LPA. Top packages have reached Rs. 12-18 LPA from leading companies.

question: Which companies visit the campus for placement drives?
answer: Leading companies including TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HCL, Accenture, Cognizant, Tech Mahindra, Capgemini, and several startups participate in campus placement drives.

question: What is the placement rate of the college?
answer: The college maintains a placement rate of approximately 85-90% for eligible students. The placement cell works year-round to bring new companies and opportunities.

question: When does the placement season begin for final year students?
answer: The placement season typically begins in August-September for final year students. Pre-placement talks and aptitude training start from the third year onwards.

question: Does the college provide internship opportunities?
answer: Yes, the placement cell coordinates internship programs with industry partners. Students can also apply for AICTE-NEAT internships and industry-sponsored projects.

question: What training is provided to students for placement preparation?
answer: The placement cell provides aptitude training, communication skills workshops, mock interviews, group discussion sessions, and resume building assistance throughout the year.

question: What scholarships are available for students?
answer: Available scholarships include government merit scholarships, minority scholarships, sports scholarships, and college-specific scholarships for academically excellent students.

question: How can I apply for a merit scholarship?
answer: Merit scholarships are awarded based on academic performance. Applications are accepted through the scholarship portal at the beginning of each academic year with required documents.

question: Is there a scholarship for economically weaker sections?
answer: Yes, Post-Matric Scholarships and fee waivers are available for students from economically weaker sections. Income certificate and other documents are required for application.

question: Can students avail education loans easily?
answer: Yes, the college has tie-ups with several nationalized banks including SBI, PNB, and Bank of Baroda for educational loans. The college provides necessary documents for loan processing.

question: What is the scholarship amount for top-ranking students?
answer: Top-ranking students (rank 1 in class) receive a full fee waiver for the subsequent semester. Second and third rank holders receive 50% and 25% fee concession respectively.

question: What sports facilities are available on campus?
answer: The campus has facilities for cricket, football, basketball, volleyball, badminton, table tennis, chess, and a modern gymnasium. Coaching is provided by qualified sports instructors.

question: Is there a canteen or food court on campus?
answer: Yes, the campus has a fully operational canteen and food court providing hygienic, affordable meals and snacks. The menu includes both vegetarian and non-vegetarian options.

question: What medical facilities are available on campus?
answer: The college has a medical center with a qualified doctor and nurses available during working hours. Emergency medical facilities and first aid are available round the clock in the hostel.

question: Is Wi-Fi available across the campus?
answer: Yes, the entire campus including classrooms, library, hostel, and common areas is covered with high-speed Wi-Fi. Students receive login credentials after admission.

question: What laboratory facilities are available for practical learning?
answer: The college has well-equipped laboratories including computer labs, electronics labs, physics and chemistry labs, language labs, and specialized research labs for each engineering branch.

question: Is there a transportation facility for day scholars?
answer: Yes, the college operates buses on multiple routes covering the city and nearby areas. Students can avail semester-wise bus passes at subsidized rates.

question: What are the college working hours?
answer: The college functions from Monday to Saturday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM. Administrative offices are open from 9:00 AM to 4:30 PM.

question: How can I contact the college administration?
answer: You can reach the college administration via phone at the numbers listed on the official website, by email, or by visiting the administrative block during working hours.

question: Is the college affiliated with a university?
answer: Yes, the college is affiliated with the state technical university and all degree programs are approved by AICTE (All India Council for Technical Education).

question: What is the dress code policy of the college?
answer: The college follows a formal dress code. Students are required to wear the prescribed college uniform on all working days. Identity cards must be worn at all times on campus.

question: Are there any student clubs or extracurricular activities?
answer: Yes, the college has various student clubs including Technical Club, Cultural Club, Sports Club, NSS, NCC, Debate Club, Photography Club, and Entrepreneurship Cell.

question: How is student attendance tracked?
answer: Attendance is recorded using biometric systems and manual registers. Minimum 75% attendance is mandatory to appear in end-semester examinations.
